{{Otheruses|Imperial research facility}}
A '''research facility''' was located on a [[frozen moon]] in a remote [[UR-2212-GR system/Legends|star system]]. It was the site of a top secret [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] experiment involving the [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] of several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] using extracts of their DNA. Authorized by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], the facility contained two entrances and was very extensive, spreading across several floors underground. A [[Spaarti cloning cylinder|cloning machine]] was located in the heart of the facility, along with quarters for the clones and [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] who worked there. The experiment failed, however, as the clones went mad and killed all of the scientists there. In [[41 ABY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]] received a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and embarked on a [[Mission to the frozen moon|mission]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]], where he found the facility. There, he dueled and killed [[Alpha (clone)|Alpha]], a clone of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kam Solusar]]. However, the other clones escaped the facility.
